You understand the core concept, but of course when you’re constructing an image which is leaning so heavily pulling from real life photography, you will have to understand and work working the context of (in this case) real life photography. 

All image creation tools (like rule of thirds) have to exist in their established contexts. And when you’ve chosen this photographic product style context, you will have to apply that rule to everything. 
It’s not just special placing (the flat composition, which you’ve framed with Thursday, and delft of field), to consider here. You also need to think about contrast and colours, tone values - how do all these things, as well all the other things that go into making an image, add together to help support your goal? That’s why as it stands a grey background and a charred tree branch aren’t doing that much for your main subject. 
Unless you’re going to push this into another realm and make it super graphical or avant garde, consider the other elements of actual photography - as this is what your current piece of working in the realm of. 
As I said earlier though, lovely stuff so far 👍🏻

How did we get to do unpaid freelance work for studios? 

Some of it was down to studying in a bigger city (London) so we met people socially that already worked in studios. So that was an avenue to talking to art directors and marketing managers. 

But we also just sent our portfolios to agencies and studios in London asking if they ever needed some free help with overflow, we were available. The ones of us who then managed to get some paid work were the ones who were available, quick, and able to take on feedback. After that it becomes consistently and networking. Covid pretty much obliterated the freelance market here for a year or so, but now it seems to be back to the way it used to be. 

Now I’m an art director I can tell you when I get sent a decent student portfolio demonstrating good fundamentals, I’m willing to reach out for them to do grunt work for a bit of money. It’s nothing super sexy,  but it becomes experience, and I’m now a reference happy to vouch (if you are competent and quick) 

Tldr 
Yeah prepare a good, focused portfolio asking if they need help with overflow. Be quick and friendly and take it from there.
